rows: a red fox in fresh snow, morning light
the fox lifts its head and snow drifts past
a heron standing in a misty pond
the heron spreads its wings and takes off
a lighthouse on a cliff at dusk
waves break below as the beam sweeps
a cabin in a pine forest, smoke from the chimney
smoke curls up, branches sway in the wind
a paper boat on a rain puddle
the boat drifts as raindrops ripple the water
an old tram on a hill street
the tram rolls slowly down the hill
a cat asleep on a windowsill
the cat stretches and opens its eyes
a hot air balloon over green fields
the balloon rises, its shadow sliding over the fields
a candle on a wooden table
the flame flickers in a draught
a field of sunflowers under a blue sky
the sunflowers sway, clouds pass overhead
